_doc: Available models the config-generator (mutate-config) may propose for a bundle's main_model or a flowchart spawn-block model. This is the autoresearch-side cache of what the box can actually run — same single-source-of-truth pattern as tunables.json / benchmark-manifest.json. `models` is the ALLOWLIST: it's both what PLAN_EDIT is shown and what the STAMP guard (scripts/validate_models.py) enforces, so a mutation can never ship a hallucinated or unservable model to a paid eval. Only loop-verified ids belong in `models`. `rel_cost` is a COARSE ordering hint (haiku<sonnet<opus) for quality-per-cost reasoning; the authoritative cost is each eval's measured cost_usd. `candidates` are listed-but-unverified ids kept OUT of the allowlist (so they can't waste an eval) until a smoke check promotes them. SOURCE OF TRUTH going forward: regenerate this from the provider/model registry (axi_list_models / axi.providers, currently unmerged) via scripts/refresh_models.py once it lands — the registry does live discovery of on-box ollama/vLLM models plus the hardcoded Anthropic table.
